verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas Editor offers Checkpoints (snapshot/rollback) and Project Archive/Restore, and the official Editor MCP server lets AI agents drive automation against a live project — giving some rollback and automation-execution capability. However there is no documented review/diff mechanism specifically for AI-driven changes, and community feedback notes the lack of standard source-control integration, so 'review' of automations before/after rollback is not evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit diff/review workflow for automation changes, native git/version-control integration, and independent confirmation that checkpoints work well with MCP-driven edits.
